headline: SPIE organic revenue growth accelerates on North-West European recovery
summary: French technical services provider SPIE reported an acceleration in organic revenue growth, driven by a business rebound across North-West European markets.
why: SPIE SA delivers multi-technical engineering services covering electrical, HVAC, and energy networks across Europe.
